grammar.pt: <first item> + 是 + <same first item>，<second item> + 是 + <same second item>
grammar.pr: <first item> + shì + <same first item>, <second item> + shì + <same second item>
grammar.ds: Keep two matters or categories distinct; do not conflate them.

ex.translation: Work is work, and your personal life is a separate matter.

grammar.ds: 啊 expresses surprise; 嗯 acknowledges or agrees, with discourse-dependent intonation.

ex.translation: Mm, I agree.

grammar.ds: Link compatible or contrasting descriptions within a phrase.

ex.translation: This room is small and comfortable.

grammar.ds: Follow a specified rule, order or standard.

ex.translation: Please follow the instructions when using this computer.

grammar.ds: Act at the scheduled time.

ex.translation: Please hand in your homework on time.

grammar.ds: A percentage, with a denominator of one hundred.

ex.translation: Eighty percent of the students agree with this plan.

grammar.ds: Original state or expectation, often contrasted with later circumstances.

ex.translation: I originally wanted to take the train, but now I've decided to fly.

grammar.ds: Refute an expected claim with emphatic negation.

ex.translation: You think I'm angry, but actually I'm not angry at all.

grammar.ds: Compelled action through a double negative, often reluctant.

ex.translation: The rain is too heavy; I have no choice but to cancel today's activity.

grammar.ds: One result holds across question-word or explicit alternatives.

ex.translation: Wherever you go, I'll support you.

grammar.ds: The result holds even without the first condition.

ex.translation: Even without looking at a map, I can find that hospital.

grammar.pt: (不仅 / 不光) + <first clause>，(还 / 而且) + <second clause>
grammar.pr: (bù jǐn / bù guāng) + <first clause>, (hái / ér qiě) + <second clause>
grammar.ds: Add a stronger point using the new 不仅/不光 realizations.

ex.translation: Not only can he swim, he can also teach children to swim.

grammar.pr: bù shì + <rejected interpretation>, ér shì + <corrected interpretation>
grammar.ds: Replace an incorrect interpretation, not offer two alternatives.

ex.translation: It's not that I'm unwilling to help you; I just don't have time.

grammar.pr: bù shì + <first option>, jiù shì + <second option>
grammar.ds: One of a limited pair of likely alternatives.

ex.translation: On weekends, he either reads at home or goes for a walk in the park.

grammar.ds: Not particularly; a limited degree rather than total negation.

ex.translation: I'm not particularly hungry today.

grammar.ds: Add a contributing circumstance to an explanation.

ex.translation: I didn't sleep well last night, and work has been too busy today, so I'm very tired now.

grammar.ds: Cause a resulting experience or action, not necessarily an instruction.

ex.translation: This activity makes me more confident.

grammar.pr: (chà diǎn r / chà yī diǎn r) + <verb phrase>
grammar.ds: Nearly occurred but normally did not; negated variants need separate pragmatic treatment.

ex.translation: I almost forgot to bring my key.

grammar.ds: Do anew, potentially changing how it is done.

ex.translation: This answer isn't correct. Please try answering again.

grammar.ds: Formal this; directly modifies a noun.

ex.translation: This road is blocked. Please go that way.

grammar.ds: Add a coordinated, often strengthening assertion.

ex.translation: He agrees with this plan and is also willing to take part in the activity.

grammar.ds: Add a limiting qualification; often softer than a direct contradiction.

ex.translation: This piece of clothing looks nice, but it's a little expensive.

grammar.ds: Add a separate point or consideration.

ex.translation: Please bring your ID card. Also, don't forget to bring a photo.

grammar.ds: Connect clauses in contrast or parallel comparison.

ex.translation: I like a lively atmosphere, whereas my younger sister likes quiet.

grammar.ds: Introduce a contrary fact; relatively written discourse.

ex.translation: He prepared very carefully; nevertheless, he still didn't pass the exam.

grammar.ds: A subsequent event follows from the preceding situation.

ex.translation: I had forgotten my umbrella, so I went home to get it.

grammar.ds: Never across the relevant period; 从 is restricted to negatives.

ex.translation: I never drink alcohol.

grammar.ds: Always so over the relevant history; affirmative habitual assessment.

ex.translation: He has always taken his work very seriously.

grammar.ds: Approximate quantity rather than an exact figure.

ex.translation: We walked about three kilometers.

grammar.ds: 当 locates an event; 等 waits for a future occasion before proceeding.

ex.translation: We'll set off once the rain stops.

grammar.ds: Read denominator before numerator.

ex.translation: One third of the students live at school.

grammar.ds: Set the target or scope of an attitude or discussion.

ex.translation: I have no objection to this suggestion.

grammar.ds: Exclaim at a high degree, not ask its measurement.

ex.translation: How fresh the air is up on the mountain!

grammar.ds: Hurry to act without delay.

ex.translation: The movie is about to start. Hurry inside.

grammar.pt: 各 + <group or place noun> / 各 + <measure word> + <noun>
grammar.pr: gè + <group or place noun> / gè + <measure word> + <noun>
grammar.ds: Each relevant group, place or measured unit.

ex.translation: Each class has its own activities.

grammar.ds: Respectfully address or refer to several people.

ex.translation: Teachers, please take your seats.

grammar.ds: Various kinds of something.

ex.translation: There are all kinds of fruit at the market.

grammar.ds: Set an explicit baseline for a comparison.

ex.translation: Compared with last year, there is more rain this year.

grammar.ds: A still greater degree relative to a baseline.

ex.translation: After practicing, I feel even more confident.

grammar.ds: Total the quantities under discussion.

ex.translation: Three tickets, ninety yuan in total.

grammar.ds: A notably high degree, often evaluative; not merely sufficient quantity.

ex.translation: This box is really heavy; I can't move it by myself.

grammar.ds: Act intentionally rather than accidentally.

ex.translation: I wasn't late on purpose; there was a traffic jam.

grammar.ds: Restrict a quantity, participant or activity; 光 colloquial, 仅 more formal.

ex.translation: All I've had today is a cup of coffee; I haven't eaten yet.

grammar.ds: Echo a claim dismissively or incredulously; not ongoing activity.

ex.translation: And you say you're not sleepy! You even fell asleep just now.

grammar.ds: An abrupt, unexpected occurrence.

ex.translation: The door suddenly opened.

grammar.ds: A frequent, typical outcome under recurring circumstances.

ex.translation: When the weather is hot, I often can't sleep well.

grammar.ds: Even a conceded hypothetical condition does not change the result.

ex.translation: Even if it rains tomorrow, we'll set off on time.

grammar.ds: Balance two compatible properties or actions.

ex.translation: This method is both simple and effective.

grammar.ds: Derive a conclusion from an accepted fact.

ex.translation: Since you've already decided, let's begin.

grammar.ds: Prospective event; relatively formal, not desire.

ex.translation: The school will hold a sports meet.

grammar.pt: 尽管 + <concessive fact>，(但是 / 可是) + <clause>
grammar.pr: jǐn guǎn + <concessive fact>, (dàn shì / kě shì) + <clause>
grammar.ds: Concede an actual circumstance before a conflicting outcome.

ex.translation: Although she was very tired, she still finished the work.

grammar.ds: An outcome contrary to expectation.

ex.translation: He actually remembers my birthday!

grammar.ds: Press for the actual answer; retain an interrogative expression.

ex.translation: Which book exactly do you want to buy?

grammar.ds: Colloquial even-if concession; not identifying 是.

ex.translation: Even if you don't agree, I still want to give it a try.

grammar.pr: (jiù shì shuō / zhè jiù shì shuō) + <explanation>
grammar.ds: Restate an implication or clarify what was meant.

ex.translation: Visits are free today; in other words, you don't need to buy a ticket.

grammar.ds: A cautious prediction, often concerned or politely discouraging.

ex.translation: With rain this heavy, I'm afraid it isn't safe to go up the mountain now.

grammar.pr: (lái de jí / lái bu jí) + <verb phrase>
grammar.ds: Have or lack enough time before a deadline.

ex.translation: The movie starts at eight; if we go now, we still have time to buy tickets.

grammar.ds: Persistently or repeatedly; often conveys annoyance.

ex.translation: You're always late, and everyone is very unhappy about it.

grammar.pt: 连 + <even case> + (也 / 都) + <predicate>，<stronger case> + 更 + <predicate>
grammar.ds: Infer a stronger case from an already striking one.

ex.translation: Even adults can't move this box, so children certainly can't.

grammar.ds: Close an illustrative list, optionally naming its category.

ex.translation: I bought fruit such as apples and bananas.

grammar.ds: Take an item as an example for discussion.

ex.translation: Take transportation, for example: the subway here is very convenient.

grammar.ds: Challenge a claim rhetorically, usually favoring the opposite answer.

ex.translation: I've already apologized. Surely you're willing to forgive me now?

grammar.ds: Give the consequence if the preceding requirement is not met.

ex.translation: Please remember your PIN; otherwise, you won't be able to withdraw money.

grammar.ds: Go on with your own activity; dismiss outside concern or interference.

ex.translation: You carry on with what you're doing; I'll go to the hospital on my own.

grammar.ds: Formal coordination of nominal expressions.

ex.translation: Both teachers and students took part in the activity.

grammar.ds: Formal attributive linker, not freely interchangeable in every 的 phrase.

ex.translation: This bridge is called the Bridge of Friendship.

grammar.ds: Size modifies the measured unit inside a quantity phrase.

ex.translation: I ate a large bowl of rice.

grammar.pt: <number> + (打 / 袋 / 棵 / 台 / 幅) + <compatible noun>
grammar.ds: Dozens, bagfuls, plants, machines or pictures; select the compatible measure.

ex.translation: I bought two bags of bread.

grammar.ds: Boxfuls, roomfuls or tablefuls; borrowed containers or occupied spaces.

ex.translation: He gave me a box of chocolates.

grammar.ds: Approximately a round number; not unrestricted after every numeral.

ex.translation: About ten children are playing in the park.

grammar.ds: An occasional rather than regular event.

ex.translation: I occasionally write letters to friends.

grammar.pt: <predicate> + 就 + <same predicate> + 吧 / <adjective> + 就 + <same adjective> + 点儿 + 吧
grammar.pr: <predicate> + jiù + <same predicate> + ba / <adjective> + jiù + <same adjective> + diǎn r + ba
grammar.ds: Reluctantly accept an action or degree despite a drawback.

ex.translation: All right, so they're a little expensive; these shoes are comfortable to wear.

grammar.ds: Concede a point, usually anticipating a qualification.

ex.translation: It is expensive, I'll grant you, but I really like it.

grammar.ds: Concede the repeated point, then state a reservation.

ex.translation: It is cheap, admittedly, but the room is a bit small.

grammar.pt: <mental verb or adjective> + (死了 / 得厉害)
grammar.pr: <mental verb or adjective> + (sǐ le / de lì hai)
grammar.ds: Extreme degree; select compatible emotional or descriptive predicates.

ex.translation: I'm absolutely exhausted and want to rest for a bit.

grammar.ds: Formal person-denoting nominalizer; use established compatible formations.

ex.translation: Readers may read books here.

grammar.ds: Strongly urge or warn; often before a prohibition.

ex.translation: Whatever you do, don't forget to bring your passport!

grammar.ds: Total ratio; distinguish from an increase by that many times.

ex.translation: This year's income is twice last year's.

grammar.pt: <approximate time or number> + (左右 / 前后)
grammar.pr: <approximate time or number> + (zuǒ yòu / qián hòu)
grammar.ds: 左右 approximates quantities or time; 前后 normally approximates a time point.

ex.translation: The meeting starts at around ten.

grammar.ds: Confirm that a claim really holds.

ex.translation: This method really does work.

grammar.pt: (让 / 叫) + 你 + <action>，你 + 就 + <same action>
grammar.ds: Insist on following the requested action without argument.

ex.translation: If you're told to sit, then sit!

grammar.ds: Any member, without restricting the choice.

ex.translation: Anyone is welcome to take part.

grammar.ds: A restricted bounded disposal reading supported by manner and context.

ex.translation: Close the door gently; the child is sleeping.

grammar.ds: A bounded disposal event with an appropriate telic verb.

ex.translation: I shut the door.

grammar.ds: Quantify the handling action's duration or repetitions.

ex.translation: Read this letter three times through.

grammar.pt: <subject> + 把 + <known object> + <verb> + (<same verb> / 一 + <same verb> / 了 + <same verb>)
grammar.pr: <subject> + bǎ + <known object> + <verb> + (<same verb> / yī + <same verb> / le + <same verb>)
grammar.ds: Brief handling through licensed verb reduplication; inserted 一/了 depends on the verb.

ex.translation: I had a quick read through this letter.

grammar.ds: Praise or criticize a person for their action; shared pivot.

ex.translation: The teacher praised her for helping her classmates.

grammar.ds: Fall short of a comparison target; understood property may be omitted.

ex.translation: The younger brother isn't as tall as the older one.

grammar.ds: Emphatic refusal to act, not corrective identification.

ex.translation: You want me to go? No way am I going!

grammar.ds: Dare to act; courage rather than ability.

ex.translation: Do you dare sing in front of everyone?

grammar.ds: An unexpectedly true or noteworthy assessment; not additive or continuing 还.

ex.translation: I thought this place wasn't any good, but the food here is actually really tasty!

grammar.ds: Participants act reciprocally; the verb must permit reciprocal relations.

ex.translation: We help each other.

grammar.ds: Formal object disposal, not the future adverb.

ex.translation: She places the phone on the table.

grammar.ds: Colloquial passive with an expressed agent; not permission or command.

ex.translation: My younger brother drove my car away.

grammar.ds: All members, with no exception.

ex.translation: All the classmates came.

grammar.ds: A contrast against an expectation or preceding fact.

ex.translation: It's cold outside, yet he has put on only a shirt.

grammar.pt: <subject> + (收 / 选) + <selected person> + (做 / 当 / 为) + <role>
grammar.ds: Accept or select someone in a role; compatible verb-role pairings only.

ex.translation: Everyone chose him as team captain.

grammar.ds: Formal co-participant or relational counterpart.

ex.translation: I'd like to discuss this matter with you.

grammar.ds: A slight degree or small adjustment.

ex.translation: A little slower, please.

grammar.ds: High degree; not a numerical ten-point quantity.

ex.translation: I'm very satisfied with this room.

grammar.pt: 首先 + <first clause>，(其次 / 然后) + <second clause>
grammar.pr: shǒu xiān + <first clause>, (qí cì / rán hòu) + <second clause>
grammar.ds: Firstly then secondly, or first then a later step.

ex.translation: First we wash our hands, then we eat.

grammar.ds: A possible, uncertain outcome.

ex.translation: Perhaps he's at home.

grammar.pt: (说什么 / 怎么 / 怎么着) + 也 + 得 + <verb phrase>
grammar.pr: (shuō shén me / zěn me / zěn me zhe) + yě + děi + <verb phrase>
grammar.ds: Whatever happens, the action must be taken.

ex.translation: Tomorrow's meeting is important; I have to attend no matter what.

grammar.ds: Add an unexpectedly stronger case on an implied scale.

ex.translation: He works ten hours a day and doesn't even rest on weekends.

grammar.ds: The main situation develops alongside a changing circumstance.

ex.translation: As the weather gets warmer, more and more people go to the park.

grammar.ds: Can or cannot manage or complete an action; 了 is liǎo.

ex.translation: I can't manage this much rice.

grammar.ds: Count bounded performances, contests or comparable events.

ex.translation: I watched two matches yesterday.

grammar.ds: Count meals or bounded bouts such as scolding.

ex.translation: We ate three meals today.

grammar.ds: Count trips rather than objects or distance.

ex.translation: I'm going to make a trip to the hospital tomorrow.

grammar.pt: <verb> + 一 + <measure word> + 是 + 一 + <measure word>
grammar.ds: Count each achieved unit pragmatically, without assuming future units.

ex.translation: There's not much time left; every page you can read counts.

grammar.ds: Coordinate compatible actions or descriptions; relatively written.

ex.translation: Please read and reply to this email.

grammar.ds: Act so that a desired later action becomes possible.

ex.translation: Please write the address clearly so the driver can find this place.

grammar.ds: Simply do it; reassurance or insistence that nothing else is needed.

ex.translation: Don't worry; just tell the teacher, that's all you need to do.

grammar.pt: <action> + 也 + 得 + <same action>，不 + <same action> + 也 + 得 + <same action>
grammar.pr: <action> + yě + děi + <same action>, bù + <same action> + yě + děi + <same action>
grammar.ds: The action is compulsory regardless of willingness.

ex.translation: That's the rule; you have to go whether you want to or not.

grammar.ds: Act toward an intended goal, not necessarily an achieved result.

ex.translation: We take the bus to protect the environment.

grammar.ds: Question-form assertion whose expected answer follows from context.

ex.translation: He helped everyone; who wouldn't be grateful to him?

grammar.ds: Read fractional decimal digits individually after 点.

ex.translation: This bag of apples weighs 2.05 kilograms.

grammar.ds: Paired absence in established four-syllable expressions.

ex.translation: She cares for her sick child day and night.

grammar.ds: Formal unrestricted alternatives; result remains unchanged across the choices.

ex.translation: Whichever book you choose, I'll support your choice.

grammar.ds: A colloquial hypothetical condition and its consequence.

ex.translation: If you're free tomorrow, come over to my place.

grammar.ds: Contrast consequences for a condition and its failure; first 就 optional.

ex.translation: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll go to the park; otherwise, we'll read at home.

grammar.ds: A tentative possibility, not established fact.

ex.translation: Perhaps she's already gone home.

grammar.ds: Balanced paired units or actions; use established combinations.

ex.translation: Please read this letter aloud carefully, word by word and sentence by sentence.

grammar.pt: 一方面 + <first clause>，另一方面 + <second clause>
grammar.pr: yī fāng miàn + <first clause>, lìng yī fāng miàn + <second clause>
grammar.ds: Present two complementary or competing considerations.

ex.translation: On the one hand, I want to travel; on the other, I'm worried about spending too much.

grammar.ds: A faceful or handful/surfaceful; conventional whole-surface descriptions.

ex.translation: He ran until his face was covered in sweat.

grammar.pt: 一 + <measure word> + 比 + 一 + <measure word> + <adjective>
grammar.ds: An escalating member-to-member comparison, often emphatic rather than a literal ranking.

ex.translation: Each of these children seems cleverer than the last.

grammar.ds: Formal already; the situation has been reached.

ex.translation: The meeting has ended; please go home, everyone.

grammar.ds: Assign responsibility for performing an action.

ex.translation: I'll be responsible for arranging this meeting.

grammar.ds: Single out a particularly prominent case.

ex.translation: I like fruit, especially bananas.

grammar.ds: Attribute an outcome to a nominal cause.

ex.translation: The match was canceled because of heavy rain.

grammar.ds: Relatively formal causal link; initial 由于 may be omitted.

ex.translation: The train was delayed, so we arrived late.

grammar.ds: Paired presence or qualities in established four-syllable expressions.

ex.translation: The children went home chatting and laughing.

grammar.ds: There is plenty; emphatic abundance, not some members.

ex.translation: Don't rush; we've got plenty of time.

grammar.pt: (有什么 / 没有什么) + (<verb phrase> / 好 + <verb phrase>) + 的
grammar.pr: (yǒu shén me / méi yǒu shén me) + (<verb phrase> / hǎo + <verb phrase>) + de
grammar.ds: Rhetorical or direct dismissal of grounds for an action or reaction.

ex.translation: This is only a small problem; what's there to worry about?

grammar.ds: Repeat an event; not restricted to future repetition.

ex.translation: He apologized to the teacher again.

grammar.ds: Limit a claim to a stated area or respect.

ex.translation: He has a lot of experience when it comes to caring for children.

grammar.ds: No further occurrence; 不 prospective, 没 retrospective.

ex.translation: That restaurant is too expensive; I'm never going there again.

grammar.pt: 怎么 + (都 / 也) + (不 / 没) + <verb phrase>
grammar.ds: No success or change despite every attempted way.

ex.translation: I've read this question three times, but I still can't make sense of it.

grammar.ds: A circumstance fits or coincides exactly.

ex.translation: There are two of us, so two seats are just enough.

grammar.ds: Accept the remaining course because alternatives are unavailable.

ex.translation: There are no buses left, so we have no choice but to walk home.

grammar.ds: A lower bound on an amount or requirement.

ex.translation: I need at least three days.

grammar.pt: (自 / 由) + <starting time or place> + <verb phrase>
grammar.ds: Formal starting point in time or space.

ex.translation: Starting in September, the library opens at nine every day.

grammar.ds: Evaluate or act in a stated capacity.

ex.translation: As a doctor, she cares a great deal about her patients.

examples.translation: Sunlight shines in through the window.
The room is too small to fit this much furniture.
My younger brother's room is very messy.
He hangs the sign on the door.
There is smoke in the kitchen; please open the window.
The child is playing in the yard.
You're so careless—you've forgotten your key again.
My mirror has been polished until it shines brightly.
The living room is bright, so there is no need to turn on a lamp during the day.
He's wearing glasses and holding a book.
Today's temperature is below zero; you need to wear a sweater when you go out.
This towel is for the guests to use.
The table is too low for the child to sit comfortably.
This kind of hat is in fashion this year.
Take off those dirty socks and put on a clean pair.
The towel is dry now and ready to use.
I am having fast food at the office at noon today.
This box is already full.
The table is heavy; let's lift it together.
This knife is too big; I'd like a smaller one.
Please give me a cup of fruit juice.
This plate of food is very spicy; eat only a little.
This tea has already gone cold.
This apple is too sour.
